reason: Hypothesis B more directly addresses the research question by proposing a testable mechanism (sluggish diffusion suppressing dislocation recovery) that explains both plastic strain and toughness, with a clear predicted outcome (higher activation energy, improved work-hardening) and a well-defined falsification experiment. Hypothesis A focuses narrowly on edge dislocation pinning, which is less comprehensive for explaining toughness and is partially contradicted by evidence E3 showing edge dislocations can be mobile in some BCC HEAs.
